results.label: King's Chamber volume, floor to ceiling
results.formula: V = length x width x height

results.label: Grand Gallery volume from its surveyed section
results.formula: V = S (l_floor cos(a) + l_roof) / 2 - V_step; S = slot + lower wall + seven laps; V_step = (h_step - l_step tan(a) / 2) l_step w

results.label: Water pressure at the foot of the Descending Passage with the Gallery full
results.formula: p = rho g (z_gallery_roof - z_passage_end)

results.label: Force on a piston at the foot of the Descending Passage, Gallery full
results.formula: F = rho g (z_gallery_roof - z_passage_end) w h

results.label: Force on a piston at the entrance of the Descending Passage, Gallery full
results.formula: F = rho g (z_gallery_roof - z_entrance) w h

results.label: Ideal work to lift one fill from pavement level
results.formula: W = rho g sum(V z_centroid) over the Gallery, the Queen's Chamber with its niche, the Queen's passage, the Ascending Passage and the well shaft above the pavement

results.label: Strokes to fill the Gallery if a stroke sweeps the whole Descending Passage
results.formula: N = V_gallery / (l_passage w h)

results.label: Strokes to fill the Gallery if a stroke sweeps the passage below the Ascending Passage junction
results.formula: N = V_gallery / ((l_passage - l_to_junction) w h)

results.label: Strokes to fill the Gallery if a stroke sweeps the passage below pavement level
results.formula: N = V_gallery / ((-z_passage_end / sin(a)) w h)

results.label: Suction-lift margin for a pump at the foot of the Descending Passage at the Old Kingdom flood peak
results.formula: margin = (p_atm - p_vapour) / (rho g) - (z_base_asl + z_passage_end - z_flood_asl); negative means no draw

results.label: Pressure drop that draws replacement air down both King's Chamber shafts while the Gallery drains
results.formula: dp = K_n rho_air v_n^2 / 2; v_n = (V_gallery / t_drain) / (A_n + A_s sqrt(K_n / K_s))

results.label: Leak-off through the Gallery's masonry joints if they stand open
results.formula: Q = l_joints rho g b^3 i / (12 mu)

results.label: Sulfur dioxide the King's Chamber holds if filled with the pure gas
results.formula: n = p V / (R T)

results.label: Acid strength ceiling set by the sulfur in one King's Chamber of gas
results.formula: c = n_SO2 / V_gallery

results.label: Acid strength ceiling if the oxygen must arrive in the same Gallery-volume of drawn gas
results.formula: c = x p / (R T); x = 1 / (1 + 0.5 / x_O2), the sulfur dioxide share of a stoichiometric mixture with air

results.label: Adiabatic temperature rise of the Gallery water for the largest batch
results.formula: dT = -dH c / (rho cp); c = n_SO2 / V_gallery

results.label: Time for the oxygen of one full batch to cross the still water surface in the Gallery
results.formula: t = (0.5 n_SO2 - c_O2 V_gallery) / (k_L c_O2 A); c_O2 = H x_O2 p; A = S / tan(a)

results.label: Share of a full batch that the oxygen in the Gallery water and across its still surface can oxidise in one day
results.formula: y = min(1, (c_O2 V_gallery + k_L c_O2 A t) / (0.5 n_SO2)); c_O2 = H x_O2 p; A = S / tan(a); t = 86400 s

results.label: Shortest possible lifetime of sulfur dioxide against uncatalysed oxidation in air
results.formula: t = 1 / (k n_O2); k = Z exp(-E / (R T)); E = dfH(SO3) + dfH(O) - dfH(SO2); n_O2 = x_O2 p / (k_B T)

results.label: Direct lightning strikes on the pyramid per year, at most
results.formula: N = N_g pi (3 H)^2 C_d, the collection area of a pointed structure; N_g counts all lightning

results.label: Charge relaxation time of the limestone masonry
results.formula: tau = eps0 eps_r rho

results.label: Charge relaxation time of the granite, driest measured case
results.formula: tau = eps0 eps_r / sigma

results.label: Skin depth in the masonry at the 2018 study's first resonance
results.formula: 1/delta = w sqrt(mu0 eps0 eps_r / 2) sqrt(sqrt(1 + t^2) - 1); t = 1 / (rho w eps0 eps_r); w = 2 pi c0 / wavelength

results.label: Skin depth in the masonry at a lightning return-stroke frequency
results.formula: 1/delta = w sqrt(mu0 eps0 eps_r / 2) sqrt(sqrt(1 + t^2) - 1); t = 1 / (rho w eps0 eps_r); w = 2 pi f

results.label: Surface displacement of the granite in a lightning-level field
results.formula: u = d E L

results.label: Sound intensity that displacement radiates into air during the stroke's rise
results.formula: I = Z_air v^2 / 2; v = d E L / t_rise

results.label: Sound level from the antechamber's granite leaf driven at the air-breakdown field
results.formula: L = 20 log10(Z_air v / sqrt(2) / p_ref); v = 2 pi f d E L_leaf

results.label: Sound level in air needed to cavitate a wet film from the gas side
results.formula: L = 10 log10(I_cav Z_air / p_ref^2) - 10 log10(4 Z_air Z_water / (Z_air + Z_water)^2)

results.label: Sound level from the Queen's Chamber shaft slab driven at the air-breakdown field
results.formula: L = 20 log10(Z_air v / sqrt(2) / p_ref); v = 2 pi f d E L_slab, with the granite coefficient lent to limestone

results.label: Path loss from the south slab to the north slab of the Queen's Chamber shafts at 13 kHz
results.formula: loss = alpha (l_south + l_north) + 2 (T(air, stone) + T(stone, water)); T(a, b) = -10 log10(4 Z_a Z_b / (Z_a + Z_b)^2); soft limestone, liquid at both shaft mouths

results.label: Vein-to-rock conductivity contrast a vein needs to carry current over the link length
results.formula: K = 2 pi l^2 / (A ln(2 l / a)); a = sqrt(A / pi)

results.label: Share of its drive water that a hydraulic ram delivers to the Gallery roof
results.formula: q/Q = efficiency x fall / lift; fall = -z_passage_end, from a supply at pavement level; lift = z_gallery_roof - z_passage_end

results.label: Height of the pit bottom, as it stood before 1837, above the Old Kingdom flood peak
results.formula: h = z_base_asl + z_pit_bottom - z_flood_asl; positive means the pit ends above the water

results.label: Margin to boiling if the first of the claimed fills takes the whole heat of the largest batch
results.formula: margin = T_boil - T_water - N dT; dT = -dH c / (rho cp); c = n_SO2 / V_gallery; N = number of claimed fills

results.label: Share of the strongest batch that bare limestone neutralises before gypsum can coat it
results.formula: x = min(1, (s rho / c)^2); c = n_SO2 / V_gallery; gypsum saturates at [Ca] = (s rho)^2 / c, and each calcium ion dissolved has neutralised one molecule of acid

results.label: Hydrogen chloride pressure over the dilute acid and salt mixture
results.formula: p = [H+] [Cl-] / H_effective

results.label: Speed-up of a dry-gas reaction by the temperature swing of the strongest airborne ultrasound
results.formula: gain = I0(E dT / (R T^2)); dT = T (gamma - 1) / gamma x p_peak / p_atm; p_peak = sqrt(2) p_ref 10^(L / 20)

S09.basis: No reservoir or inlet is evidenced on site, so the step is conditional on the reservoir of S08; water standing at the level of a pavement-level reservoir stops 21.7 m below the top of the well shaft and 51.5 m below the Gallery roof, a head that the pump of S10 must supply.

S10.basis: The hypothesis names no actuator or seal for the pump, which must push with 0.43 to 1.01 MN depending on its position and hold 0.80 MPa with the Gallery full.

S11.basis: The suction margin of a pump at the foot of the Descending Passage is -5.9 m at the Old Kingdom flood peak and -0.4 m at the most favourable documented levels, against the 0 m it needs to draw.

S12.basis: Filling the Gallery alone takes 4.3 strokes (3.9 to 4.7 over the ranges of the inputs) if a stroke sweeps the whole Descending Passage, 5.9 (5.4 to 6.4) if it sweeps the part below the Ascending Passage junction and 6.7 (6.2 to 7.3) if it sweeps the part below the pavement, against the 4 claimed, and the hypothesis fixes no stroke.

S16.basis: At the collision limit, sulfur dioxide lasts 2.8e+17 s (8.8e+09 years) against oxygen with no catalyst, so a pass of 10 min to 6 h converts a fraction of 9e-14 at most and 2e-15 at the least.

S20.basis: In one day, taken as the cycle because the hypothesis states none, the oxygen dissolved in the Gallery water and the oxygen crossing its still surface can oxidise 2.5 percent of a full batch (2.1 to 2.8 percent over the ranges of the inputs), below the 5 percent under which the criterion fails the claim and the 50 percent from which it passes it; a still surface would need 27 days (22 to 302 days over the ranges of the inputs) to bring the yield to 5 percent, and the hypothesis describes no aeration.

S21.basis: If the first of the 4 claimed fills took the whole heat of the largest batch, it would warm by 7.3 K and leave a margin of 72.7 K below boiling (62.3 K at the least), so nothing boils over with or without the dilute-acid step.

S22.basis: No Tier 0 rule; tested in piece 4.

S24.basis: The largest possible batch warms the Gallery water by 1.8 K (2.0 K at most), below the 5 K at which a heat exchanger would start to matter.

S25.basis: A slab driven at the air-breakdown field emits 50 dB and the path to the north slab loses 101 dB at 13 kHz, so the signal arrives at -51 dB (-55 dB at the least), against the 10 dB needed above a 0 dB noise floor.

S26.basis: No Tier 0 rule; tested in piece 3.

S27.basis: Hydrogen chloride stands at 1.2e-07 atm over the dilute acid and salt mixture, and at 1.5e-07 atm over saturated brine, against the 1e-05 atm below which the criterion fails the claim.

S28.basis: A vein must conduct 2.7e+05 times better than the rock to carry current 100 m; the best measured specular hematite reaches 3.3e+04 times in 100 ohm m rock and 1.0e+06 times in the most resistive 3000 ohm m rock, earthy red hematite reaches 4.2e-02 times at most, and no Giza vein has been measured.

S29.basis: A vein must conduct 2.7e+05 times better than the rock to carry current 100 m; the best measured specular hematite reaches 3.3e+04 times in 100 ohm m rock and 1.0e+06 times in the most resistive 3000 ohm m rock, earthy red hematite reaches 4.2e-02 times at most, and no Giza vein has been measured.

S30.basis: Pure sulfur dioxide at one atmosphere caps the product at 0.023 mol/L (0.026 mol/L at most), or 0.012 mol/L if its oxygen comes with the same draw of air, below the 0.05 mol/L pass line at any gas fraction; the ceiling scales with the sulfur dioxide fraction of the chamber gas, so the product stays above the 0.005 mol/L fail line only if that fraction is at least 22 percent (19 percent with every input at its favourable end), and the hypothesis states no gas fraction.

S31.basis: Direct strikes come at most 0.12 times per year, one every 8 years, and the hypothesis states no cycle rate to compare this with.
